_comment: Test fixture for validating the Nexus upgrade framework's handling of invalid upgrade scenarios

metadata.description: Test fixture for validating the Nexus upgrade framework's handling of invalid upgrade scenarios

testScenarios.name: Identical version detection
testScenarios.description: Tests that the upgrade framework correctly detects and reports identical source and target versions

expectedExceptions.message: Upgrade version must change: model 'foo' has identical source and target versions '1.1'

testScenarios.name: Backward version detection
testScenarios.description: Tests that the upgrade framework correctly detects and reports backward version changes

expectedExceptions.message: Upgrade version cannot go backward: model 'foo' from '1.2' to '1.1'

testScenarios.name: Empty version detection
testScenarios.description: Tests that the upgrade framework correctly detects and reports empty version strings

expectedExceptions.message: Upgrade version cannot be empty: model 'bar'

testScenarios.name: Invalid version format detection
testScenarios.description: Tests that the upgrade framework correctly detects and reports invalid version formats

expectedExceptions.message: Invalid upgrade version format: model 'baz' has invalid version format

testScenarios.name: Empty model detection
testScenarios.description: Tests that the upgrade framework correctly detects and reports empty model names

expectedExceptions.message: Upgrade model name cannot be empty

patternMatchingTests.name: Pattern matching for upgrade validation
patternMatchingTests.description: Tests that the upgrade framework correctly uses pattern matching for validation in Java 21
patternMatchingTests.expectedResult: Pattern matching correctly identifies invalid upgrade configurations

stringTemplateTests.name: String templates for error messages
stringTemplateTests.description: Tests that the upgrade framework correctly uses string templates for error messages in Java 21
stringTemplateTests.expectedResult: String templates correctly format error messages for invalid upgrade configurations

recordPatternTests.name: Record patterns for upgrade configuration
recordPatternTests.description: Tests that the upgrade framework correctly uses record patterns for upgrade configuration in Java 21
recordPatternTests.expectedResult: Record patterns correctly process upgrade configuration records

virtualThreadTests.name: Virtual threads for validation
virtualThreadTests.description: Tests that the upgrade framework correctly uses virtual threads for validation in Java 21
virtualThreadTests.expectedResult: Virtual threads correctly validate upgrade configurations in parallel
